Implemented the feature contract: wrapped the Changelist `list_editable` POST processing in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` (django/contrib/admin/options.py) inside a `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))` block, so all per-form saves, related saves, and change logging commit or roll back together.

Details:
- `transaction` and `router` were already imported at the top of the file, so no import changes were needed.
- The atomic block encloses the loop over `formset.forms` that calls `save_form`, `save_model`, `save_related`, and `log_change`, ensuring no partial state on error.
- Only the allowed file (django/contrib/admin/options.py) was edited.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (`admin_changelist`) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
